rf3.note: the one checkpoint every mode uses; passed as ckpt_path=<file> (ROSETTAFOLD3_OPT_CKPT)

msa_featurization.note: the checkpoint's own validation transform (not a CLI key); MSAs are read from the input JSON's msa_path per component, or from LOCAL_MSA_DIRS

settings.note: pred states no sampling setting of its own: rf3 fold runs at upstream's documented defaults (cli_defaults) plus one fixed seed per run (seed=<s>, the CLI's own key), and any key=value override the caller passes goes to rf3 fold verbatim (opt/rosettafold3_opt/settings.py)

pinned_stack.freeze_note: environment/requirements.lock is the pip freeze of the image (148 distributions: every line the tested interpreter reports except its own pip, this kit and the shared core), the file environment/Dockerfile installs; kit v1's MANIFEST.json (pruned) records kit v1's image's stack as a 16-entry subset ("pip_freeze_subset"; its results/pip_freeze.txt, pruned, 14 lines); no freeze of the add-on's measured runs is in the kits
